class.name: IfcRelAssigns
class.brief_description: The assignment relationship, IfcRelAssigns , is a generalization of "link" relationships among instances of IfcObject and its various 1 st level subtypes. A link denotes the specific association through which one object (the client) applies the services of other objects (the suppliers), or through which one object may navigate to other objects.
